newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bear Stearns rates Colombian banks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bear Stearns rates Colombian banks.

text.p: Bear Stearns said it has initiated formal coverage of Colombia's banking system with four recommendations, including a buy rating for preferred ADRs of Banco Ganadero, the country's largest commercial bank in terms of assets.

A statement from the Latin American Equity Research division of Bear Stearns said the aquisition last August by Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya of a 40 percent stake in Ganadero's voting stock had positioned Ganadero to become more efficient while "maintaining high net interest margins."
"We expect the bank's earnings per ADR to drop in 1997 due to the restructuring efforts of BBV and the increase in the number of shares compared to 1996," the statement said.
However, it said Bear Stearns analysts see a 40 percent upside potential to their $36 target price for Ganadero's preferred ADRs.
In its other recommendations, Bear Stearns rated local shares of Banco de Colombia and Banco de Bogota as attractive and said the same of the ADRs of Banco Industrial Colombiano.
Of BIC, Colombia's fourth largest bank, the statement said its asset quality ratios were among the best in Latin America.
